title: An infinite stable tournament has a transitive subtournament preserving a prescribed ordinal well-foundedness
author: Quentin Le Houérou; Ludovic Levy Patey; Keita Yokoyama
work: Conservation of Ramsey's theorem for pairs and well-foundedness
difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Corollary cor:sem-wf（源 1060-1066 行，证明 1067-1070 行）：在 RCA_0+BΣ_2+WF(sup_{β<α} ω^{β⨯ω}) 的可数模型上，对每个无穷稳定竞赛图 R，存在 M-无穷的传递子竞赛图 G 且 M[G] 仍满足 RCA_0+BΣ_2+WF(α)。证明只有两行，但关键在于把两条外部结果精确对接：先用 ω-扩张定理造出满足 RCA_0^* 且计算上高于 Y' 的集合 P（1068 行），再把 SEM 主命题的三个前提（模型假设、R、P）逐一对上，才能读出所宣称的两条结论（1069 行）；两条引理各自的假设若错配一处就接不上。原文位置在证明的 1068-1069 行。

proof_spans.label: author proof environment immediately following the statement of cor:sem-wf

contexts.label: the theorem that every countable model of RCA_0^* can be omega-extended into a model of RCA_0^* plus WKL, invoked by the proof
the proposition that the SEM forcing produces a transitive subtournament controlling the jump and preserving well-foundedness, from which the corollary follows
